answer:
Root cause and fix are now saved as a lesson, so this won't need re-diagnosing next month — just recall "atlas release build" for the answer.

**Why it keeps happening:** the atlas CI pipeline hard-cancels any job running past 30 minutes, but every release build starts with an empty cargo registry cache (no cache persistence configured), and that cold cache alone adds ~18 minutes. That leaves almost no margin for the actual compile — it's the same failure mode each time (cancelled 2026-08-11, 2026-08-19, and now 2026-09-01).

**Fix:** persist/restore the cargo registry cache (and `target/`) between release-build CI runs, keyed on `Cargo.lock`, rather than just bumping the timeout — that also makes every future build faster, not just this one.
